notes.title: Gemini’s Log #3 - Second Patch with Mac & Linux
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/2zoCidcQ9iQXS3GosG/giphy.gif

Minor fixes to improve Algo Bot’s programmer experience.  

Added MacOS & Linux support
Added skip cinematic button
Added options menu during gameplay.
Improved level select menu
Various interface & bug fixes

notes.title: Captain’s Log #7 - Command Center
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOwG5tOD05kkfFbpu/giphy.gif

Captain's Log, Earth, Day before departure.

Last check on the Command Center before joining the Stasis Bay. After that Gemini will be in command until I wake up. 

Steam now allows developers to stream their game via the store pages. Ground control plans to try that new feature for the Launch tomorrow 14th of February 2018 on Algo Bot’s Steam page.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31583650/4de90b9bd0b70c5d23e8cebd6b813d5247229c51.jpg

Thank you for following this Captain’s Log. See you on the far side of the galaxy.

notes.title: Captain's Log #2 - Warehouse
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohs4otyVjkK5mPmsU/giphy.gif

Captain's Log, Earth, Six days before departure.

Preservation of our colonization equipment is absolutely critical to our establishment on the new planet. I verified the cargo bay myself twice. Gemini is doing a last scan as I am writing this.

notes.title: Captain's Log #1 and Live Stream with the Devs
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/26DMZ9dx7WvJNd9Bu/giphy.gif

Captain's Log, Earth, One week before departure. 

Our destination is planet Cactus 2.0 on the far side of the galaxy. My orders are to lead the pan-galactic colonization ship Europa, safely to its destination. I am still somewhat in awe of its size and complexity.  

Ground control plans to have a Launch Party on Wednesday February 14, 2018 . Happy Valentine's Day ːpaleyebrowsː. Feel free to join them on http://www.twitch.tv/fishingcactus

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31583650/6a14dcf8db0e38c8fe219fd4a2bffd05c5a18523.jpg
